sections.heading: What is this?
sections.content: A community‑driven guide on how to play against every League of Legends champion. Click any champion on the left to see detailed matchup tips, item builds, rune pages, and phase‑by‑phase advice.

sections.heading: How to use
sections.content: Use the search bar to quickly find a champion. The guide shows recommended starter, core, and situational items, plus a full rune page. Difficulty ratings help you prepare before the game.

sections.heading: Contributing
sections.content: If you'd like to add or improve a guide, check the GitHub repository. All champion data is stored as simple JSON files – pull requests are welcome!
